profile.summary:
I am a CS Graduate from the University of Pennsylvania and I am currently a Senior Software Engineer at Axle.

My technical interests include software development, data analysis, machine learning, research and financial technology.

I aim to be a part of environments that hone my engineering skills and compliment progressive thinking. I always look forward to meeting new people, exchanging knowledge, developing new ideas and making great memories.
